info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fiduciary Agreement Update API
info.description: The Fiduciary Agreement Update API facilitates the modification of existing fiduciary agreements within the banking domain. This endpoint allows for the adjustment of terms or conditions linked to a fiduciary relationship, ensuring compliance and updated alignments with client needs. Typical consumers include financial institutions and legal teams managing client agreements. By using this API, users can enhance their fiduciary agreements dynamically, maintaining accuracy and responsiveness in their banking operations.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of a specific fiduciary agreement identified by its unique ID. It is crucial for maintaining accurate and current information regarding fiduciary agreements in the lending system.
